subject: MAP: Acceptance window, procurement hold & escalation required
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acme.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP and acceptance lane for Redwood evaluation

Camila —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Acme is lined up to start legal review but we have one key blocker: our signer (VP Product) is out on travel through next week. That makes our intended close week (week of 8/23) risky.

Can you share a concise MAP (timeline + acceptance criteria) and a risk log we can attach to our internal approval packet? If we see a signer delay beyond 3 business days, we may need a formal extension and a note on conditional acceptance so our procurement doesn't push the vendor into a new fiscal window.

I attached a quick template to make review faster. Appreciate any flexibility on acceptance windows or a short courtesy credit if the delay lands in the next quarter.

Thanks,
Daniel
Procurement Manager, Acme Health
[Attachment: MAP_outline.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and acceptance lane for Redwood evaluation

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the heads-up. Attached is a focused MAP (CAM_map_v1.xlsx) and an initial risk register (risk_log.csv) that call out the signer dependency, procurement SLA expectations, and two fallback options:

- Conditional acceptance window: We propose a 10-business-day conditional acceptance from the date the SOW is sent; if the signer signs within that window, go-live and standard billing commence retroactive to the SOW date.
- Short-term pilot standby: If signer delay exceeds 10 business days, we can start a 30-day pilot using a limited Dedicated capacity profile with a capped token budget so Acme can validate acceptance criteria without full billing.

If procurement confirms the expected signer return date, we can keep to the 8/23 target. Otherwise I recommend a formal extension to 9/6 to avoid slipping into your next quarter. If needed I will escalate for a credit concession.

Notes: legal has a near-final SOW (SOW_redwood_acme_v3.docx) — I can route to your procurement for signature today and request DocuSign routing straight to the VP once they are back.

Attachments: CAM_map_v1.xlsx, risk_log.csv, SOW_redwood_acme_v3.docx

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and acceptance lane for Redwood evaluation

On Tue, Aug 17, 2027 at 11:04 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is a focused MAP (CAM_map_v1.xlsx) and an initial risk register (risk_log.csv) that call out the signer dependency...

I reviewed the risk log. Two quick ops mitigations we should propose to make the extension palatable to Acme and to avoid SLA regression:

1) Offer a temporary Dedicated capacity reservation for the pilot with a 25% discount on the pilot token consumption — keeps latency and KV-cache profiles stable for their eval workloads.
2) Provide a short-term SLO addendum for the pilot that guarantees 95th p99 latency target for up to 50 concurrent sessions; failure to meet that target triggers a credits clause (small fixed amount) to demonstrate accountability.

If Camila wants, I can draft the pilot terms and hand to Legal. Laura, do you want to own the SLO language?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acme.io>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and acceptance lane for Redwood evaluation

Camila / Team —

Quick update from our side: VP Product returned early but had to reroute several approvals. Legal can accept SOW_v3 but procurement moved our internal sign-off to 9/2 due to budget window gating. That means the requested 8/23 close can't happen unless Redwood is willing to accept a conditional approach.

Two asks from procurement:
1) A one-time courtesy credit (equivalent to 4 business days of committed capacity) if we have to push into the next fiscal bucket.
2) A short Exec escalation note confirming Redwood will hold the current rate and acceptance terms for a two-week extension while we finalize signoff.

Can Camila/Marissa confirm whether Redwood can accommodate both? The pilot option looks sensible but procurement needs the credit/hold to recommend we stay with Redwood.

Thanks,
Daniel

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.io>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and acceptance lane for Redwood evaluation — Executive confirmation

Daniel —

Thanks for the transparency. I’ve reviewed the MAP and Ben’s mitigation notes. Redwood will extend the acceptance window as follows:

• Hold current commercial terms and SOW rates for an additional 10 business days beyond the original SOW send date.
• Provide a one-time courtesy credit equal to 4 business days of expected committed capacity (applied as a billing credit if the SOW signs after the original target close).
• If the signer delay exceeds 10 business days, we will initiate the pilot standby described by Camila with the 25% pilot token discount; pilot terms to be finalized by Laura and Legal.

I’ve attached an internal approval note for our records (ExecApprovalNote.pdf). Laura — please prioritize the SLO addendum and SOW routing so Camila can share the DocuSign link to the VP.

Camila — confirm you will send the DocuSign link and we’ll mark this as an executive-held extension. Once signed we revert to standard billing with retroactive effective date per the MAP.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ExecApprovalNote.pdf]
